amendment.hashMethodDeclaration: - Amendment hash method: SHA-256 of saved UTF-8 bytes from the unique whole heading line `## 1. Binding and limited authority` through EOF, including final LF; metadata above is excluded. Locate `\n<heading>\n` and begin after the leading LF. Whole-file SHA-256 includes all saved metadata and is recorded independently in plan-probes.json; neither digest proves approval.
amendment.wholeFileHashMethod: SHA-256 of all saved bytes including final metadata and LF

plan.hashMethodDeclaration: - Plan hash method: SHA-256 over saved UTF-8 bytes beginning at the unique whole heading line `## 1. Decision and authorization boundary` through EOF, including final LF; exclude this metadata. Match `\n<heading>\n`, then begin one byte after that leading LF. Never search the first textual mention of the heading. Whole-file hashes, when needed for later approval, must be recorded separately by the parent after metadata settles.
plan.wholeFileHashMethod: SHA-256 of all saved bytes including final metadata and LF
